claims: The US dollar ($ or USD) is the legal tender currency of the United States.
The US dollar is issued by the Federal Reserve in bills of $1, $2, $5, $10, $20, $50, and $100.
The US dollar uses the symbol $ or the abbreviation USD.
Currently, seven denominations of US dollar bills circulate: $1, $2, $5, $10, $20, $50, $100.
In June 2025, 1 USD was approximately 18.98 MXN.
In mid-2025, US dollar exchange rates against the Mexican peso were close to 19 pesos.
In April 2026, the USD buy rate in Mexico was around 16.65-17.58 MXN.
In April 2026, the USD sell rate in Mexico was between 18.15-18.74 MXN.
In early April 2026, the USD exchange rate in the Dominican Republic was around RD$60-61
